home.headline: Luxury fashion for every landscape.
home.subhead: YCompany is celebrated for sweaters, moleskin, corduroy, and tattersall shirts—now with a fast, responsive boutique built for phones, tablets, and desktop.
home.featuredBody: High-quality clothing, shoes, and accessories with live inventory, instant search, and secure checkout.

products.title: Shop
products.metaDescription: Browse YCompany luxury apparel: sweaters, moleskin, corduroy, tattersall shirts, shoes, and accessories.

search.title: Search
search.metaDescription: Fast product search across YCompany sweaters, moleskin, corduroy, tattersall, and full catalog.
search.intro: Instant results as you type—filter by price and brand. Shareable URLs keep your search and filters in sync across devices.
search.noMatchesBody: Try a different search term or loosen your filters.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to view orders, save your details, and check out securely.
login.oauthError: Sign-in was cancelled or failed. Please try again.
login.socialHint: Quick sign-in with your existing account
login.privacyNote: By continuing, you agree to our terms of service and privacy policy.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Save your details, track orders, and check out faster.
signup.name: Full name (optional)
signup.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.
signup.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email on your account and we'll send a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in 1 hour.
forgotPassword.sentDevHint: Dev mode: the reset URL is logged to the server console — look for "[auth] password reset for …".

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a strong password you don't use anywhere else.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.successBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

checkout.emailHelper: We'll send your order confirmation to this address
checkout.stripeNote: Payment is handled securely by Stripe. Card details never touch our servers.
checkout.couponWarning: Coupon not applied — fix or remove it before paying.

checkoutSuccess.title: Thank you
checkoutSuccess.body: Your payment is processing with Stripe. Confirmation email follows from Stripe when the session completes.
